month_theme: Final sprint — 12 days to Phase 1, 17 days to Colorado

must_do.text: Book Colorado Springs — RIGHT NOW. RAD Hostel + flights PTY → DEN or COS. Trip is Aug 6–11, only 17 days away. Hostel and flights decided, just not booked. Do it Monday morning.
Do the Coiba trip — the pre-gap window closes Aug 1. If not already arranged, this has to happen this week or early next. Last call.
Open brokerage account — Fidelity or Schwab. Phase 1 starts in 12 days. 7+ weeks overdue. The routine starts Aug 1; the financial habit should be running before then.

should_do.text: Begin C++ self-study — learncpp.com, VSCode + GCC, 30 min/day. Phase 1 is 12 days away. Starting now means arriving Aug 1 with almost 2 weeks of momentum.

Decide Europe route — countries are still TBD. Oct 1 is 10 weeks out. Option A: Lisbon → Porto → Madrid → Paris → London. Option B: Prague → Vienna → Budapest → Amsterdam → London. Lock it in and update the Notion Europe page.

could_do.text: Join RAeS as student member (£20 at raes.org.uk) — needed before the London week in October. Takes 5 minutes now, easy to forget later.
Start Portuguese A2 prep — Phase I deliverable. Even 10 min/day on Duolingo or a structured A2 course counts. Citizenship exam prep starts now.

key_dates.event: Book RAD Hostel + flights for Colorado — first thing
Coiba trip window — must happen before Aug 1
Last full day before gap year Phase 1

notes: Colorado trip changed from RMNP backcountry (Aug 20-28) to Colorado Springs day hiking (Aug 6-11) — Garden of the Gods, Pikes Peak, Cheyenne Canyon. No backcountry permit needed. Great call for a first trip. Friend's college starts spring so this is the only viable window. Phase 1 launches in 12 days: C++ / CS50P certificates, Portuguese A2 prep, physical routine (Krav Maga + fitness), flight sim practice. The gap year you have in August is the one you build this week.
